title: Release history
content_data:
Date Version Updates
8/31/2026 iOS: 1.7.2
Unity: 1.7.2
React: 0.1.3
  • [Fix] iOS: Do not report unfinished StoreKit transactions in automatically logged IAP events. You may observe a drop in automatically reported Purchase events if transactions are not marked as finished in your app.
  • [Fix] iOS: Explicit completion handlers added for ATT requests and SDK initialisation.
  • [Feature] React Native bridge, built on SDK version 1.7.2
7/24/2026 iOS: 1.7.1
Unity: 1.7.1
  • [Fix] Fixed a race condition edge case where messages were sent to Unity during teardown, resulting in null pointer exceptions if the process was opened and killed in quick succession.
6/30/2026 1.7.0
  • [Feature] Android: Auto-IAP reporting for Google Pay billing library V8.
  • [Feature] iOS: Auto-IAP reporting for StoreKit 2.0, supporting mixed programming of Objective-C & Swift. Dynamic and static libraries are both available as release artifacts.
  • [Fix] Performance optimizations to ensure timely clearing of local cache.
  • [Fix] Unity: Optimize reporting performance, enhance user experience, and reduce the probability of stuttering.
4/6/2026 1.6.1 This version focuses on stability, accuracy, and performance improvements. Developer documentation is also restructured and rewritten for clarity.
  • [Fix] Double-hashing protections for advanced matching fields.
  • [Fix] Crash reports are now sent with the version of the SDK related to the crash, in case the SDK dependency was updated before the crash report was sent.
  • [Fix] Moved event reporting off the main thread to improve performance.
  • [Fix] Android: Gracefully degrade automatic IAP reporting in Play Billing Library V8+ environments until officially supported.
  • [Fix] iOS: Fixed an issue where automatically logged Purchase events would be sent multiple times before getting deduplicated at server side.
  • [Fix] iOS: Multiple optimisations for queue management, logging, and request handling.
  • [Fix] Unity: Fixed a compile error in the Android bridge layer.
  • [Fix] Unity: Fixed an issue where disablePayTrack was silently ignored.
12/2/2025
 1.6.0
 [Deprecation] Loan-related event constants are now deprecated.
[Feature] Android: Installer store package reporting support
[Feature] Android: Play Store billing library transactions are automatically reported by default. To avoid issues with existing manual implementations, disable automatic transaction reporting before updating and releasing your app. See 2.2 Auto IAP reporting for more detail.
[Feature] Subscription-related parameter support for automatic transaction reporting. Server-side Play Console/App Store Connect subscription reporting is not supported at this time.
[Feature] Deferred deeplink requests now return an associated click timestamp where available.
[Fix] Stability optimisations
9/3/2025 iOS: 1.5.1
Unity: 1.5.1		 [Fix] iOS: crash fixes
8/1/2025 iOS: 1.5.0
Unity: 1.5.0		 [Feature] Ad revenue mediation postback support, see iOS/Unity integration guide section 3.3 for details
[Feature] Full support for token-based test events, see iOS integration guide section 4.1 and Unity integration guide section 5.1 for details.
[Feature] Updates to support upcoming Advanced Predictive Measurement.
7/15/2025 Android: 1.5.0 [Feature] Ad revenue mediation postback support, see Android integration guide section 3.3 for details
[Feature] Full support for token-based test events, see Android integration guide section 4.1 for details.
6/12/2025 iOS: 1.4.1
Android: 1.4.1
Unity: 1.4.1@1.4.1		 [Fix] iOS: crash fixes
[Fix] Android: crash fixes
5/19/2025 iOS: 1.4.0
Android: 1.4.0
Unity: 1.4.0@1.4.0
 [Feature] Automatic event_id generation when none is specified
[Feature] session_activity support
[Feature] Enhance data postback support. See Android integration step 2.4 or iOS/Unity integration step 2.3 for details.
[Deprecation] Deprecated disableAppTrackingDialog for iOS. The SDK will no longer proactively display the ATT dialog if ATT status is not set. See iOS integration step 3.4.6 or Unity integration step 3.4.5 for details.
[Fix] android: fix get gp referrer anr
[Fix] change "price" to string
4/01/2025 7.1.0.4@1.3.7 Added documentation for a new combined TikTok App Events and Pangle SDK.
3/10/2025 iOS: 1.3.8
Android: 1.3.8
 [Feature] Deferred deep link support
[Feature] Session ID support
[Feature] Access token and payload encryption support
[Feature] Initial support for token-based test events
[Feature] Android: Google Play Install Referrer support
[Fix] iOS: Swift Package Manager support
[Fix] Other misc bugfixes
1/3/2025 Unity: 0.0.2@1.3.7 Initial release
12/18/2024 iOS: 1.3.7-1 [Fix] Updated SKAN conversion value handling to address NSCFNumber errors.
11/29/2024
 Beta 1.3.7 (Android) [Feature] Support server-side control for automatically logged events
[Feature] SDK configuration verification & improvements
[Feature] Support Unity SDK (closed beta)
8/28/2024
 Beta 1.3.6 (Android) [Fix] Fix testing issue (add initialization status and invalid value check & float precision issue)
8/15/2024 Beta 1.3.6 (iOS) [Fix] Fixed crashes caused by null values & WKWebView allocation.
7/31/2024 Beta 1.3.5
(iOS)		 [Feature] Add initialization completion handler.
[Fix] Fixed SKAN conversion value matching strategy.
7/26/2024 Beta 1.3.5 (Android) [Fix] Fix WebView ANR and add initialization callback
7/2/2024 Beta 1.3.4 (iOS) [Fix] Reenabling SDK tracking would reset payment tracking config
[Fix] Support Apple silicon simulators in XCFramework
6/28/2024 Beta 1.3.4 (Android) [Fix] Add missing currency
[Feature] SDK domain migration
[Feature] Add 'order_id' for purchase event & add 'type' for auto track event
[Feature] Add error message for config & batch request
Beta 1.3.3 (iOS) [Feature] Support SKAN 4.0
[Feature] SDK domain migration
[Feature] Add 'order_id' for purchase event & add 'type' for auto track event
[Feature] Add error message for config & batch request
5/15/2024 Beta 1.3.3 (Android) [Fixed] Android: Use 'price_amount_micros' instead of 'price' in autoIapTrack()
5/14/2024 Beta 1.3.2 [Fixed] Value parsing for amounts containing commas in autoIapTrack()
4/24/2024 Beta 1.3.1 [Feature] Multiple tiktok_app_id support (multiple ad accounts)
[Feature] iOS Privacy Manifest declaration added for Required Reason API
4/1/2024 Beta 1.3.0 [Feature] AEO/VBO optimization support
[Feature] New standard event builder class trackTTevent(), old class trackEvent() will be deprecated at a later date
[Feature] Advanced Matching (email/phone) attribution
[Feature] Android automatic IAP tracking autoIapTrack()
